snippet.title: Archa SAGE 2025 Demo - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the SAGE 2025 DEMO here: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/archa-sage-2025-demo.2498/

Check out SAGE 2025: https://sagexpo.org/

Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

As gang member-turned college student Archa (pronounced Ar-Shah), escape the Eigth-Dimension's Lobby by fighting enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and complete large levels!

#SAGE #SAGExpo2025 #indie #platformer #gamemaker #pixelart #sonic #sonicthehedgehog
